column3: The related Non-Serviced Special Servicer under the WFCM 2025-5C7 PSA will be entitled to a workout fee determined, with respect to each applicable principal and interest collection, at a workout fee rate equal to 1.00% of each payment of principal and interest (other than default interest) made on the Empire Mall Whole Loan for so long as another Special Servicing Loan Event does occur.
